cohort: Iranian women who had deliveries in 103 hospitals in Tehran during 2015 were included, irrespective of delivery method, parity, or pregnancy outcome.
finding: The study found a prevalence of unintended pregnancy in Iran of 19.81%, with economic status and number of deliveries identified as the main predicting factors.
cross-section timing: Data was gathered at the time of delivery or within 2-3 days postpartum during 2015.
